items.title: 2 Reasons to Like YUM (and 1 Not So Much)
items.summary: Over the last six months, Yum! Brands’s shares have sunk to $145.90, producing a disappointing 9.8% loss - a stark contrast to the S&P 500’s 14.2% gain. This may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: After Selling Pizza Hut, Yum! Brands Is Eyeing a New Purchase: ‘We Are Prepared to Make Bold Moves’
items.summary: Yum! Brands recently sold Pizza Hut. Now, CFO Ranjith Roy says it might be ready to add something new to replace it.

items.title: Chipotle adds former KFC Global CEO to board

items.title: Yum!’s Post–Pizza Hut Brand Shuffle Could Be A Game Changer For Yum! Brands (YUM)
items.summary: Yum! Brands has been reshaping its portfolio after selling Pizza Hut, doubling down on Taco Bell, KFC and Habit Burger & Grill while relocating Taco Bell and Habit Burger to a larger joint headquarters in Irvine to support future expansion. Hints about adding new brands, combined with infrastructure investments and strengthened global supplier relationships, highlight Yum!’s intention to broaden its restaurant platform and deepen operational capabilities. items.title: Taco Bell will move to larger Irvine headquarters
items.summary: Taco Bell and Habit Burger & Grill will move their joint headquarters to a larger campus in Irvine after spending more than 15 years near the Irvine Spectrum Center.

items.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 We’re Skeptical Of
items.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.
